已查到可引用的部分資料：

### A&D requirement → measurable parameter → Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| **Market requirement** | Aerospace / Defense context is explicitly tied to “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient” by Randy Schnell, Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test [55]. The mission drivers include tactical edge connectivity needs, smart jamming / EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, tactical private 5G networks on military bases, and secure command-and-control networks [3]. |
| **Technical mechanism to test** | The resilience problem is mapped to **5G handover signaling** and **5G frequency-hopping / FHSS capabilities** [1]. The concrete implementation is **handover frequency hopping**, using 5G handover across multiple cells / carrier frequencies so the jammer must constantly listen and readjust [1]. The prerequisite is highly reliable inter-frequency handovers while the carrier frequency is constantly changing [1]. |
| **Measurable parameters** | The test design focuses on UE-reported supported bands and handover interruption intervals from 3GPP TS 38.300 [36]. The white paper-level measurements include handover interruption, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS [43]. The described setup used a 5 s handover repetition interval, UE received power of -70.2 dBm, ping at 100 Hz / every 10 ms, iPerf updated once per second, and target UL/DL data rates of 2 Mbit/s for video-stream quality [48]. |
| **Required Signaling Tester capability** | The tester must support 5G network emulation and signaling because the mitigation is based on 5G handover signaling [1]. The white paper used R&S CMX500 as the 5G network emulator / radio communication tester [46], with two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and up to eight cells, and the test used three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 at 2.50713 GHz, 3.30087 GHz, and 4.62399 GHz [48]. CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [7]. Its listed features include NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, GUI, scripting, XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [7]. |
| **Required Non-signaling Tester capability** | For non-signaling work, the supported CMX500 Callbox use cases include sensitivity testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [16]. CMX500 is also described as supporting FR1 / FR2 RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [9]. |
| **Gap** | The passages do not establish that a **non-signaling-only** tester can validate the handover-frequency-hopping resilience mechanism, because that mechanism is explicitly mapped to 5G handover signaling [1]. The sources also do not provide jammer waveform, jammer power, tracking delay, hop prediction capability, attack success rate, jammer reacquisition time, or jamming success probability [2][45]. |
【推論】For this A&D resilience chain, the signaling tester requirement is multi-cell / multi-carrier 5G SA network emulation with inter-frequency handover control and measurement, because the market problem is smart-jamming resilience in tactical/private 5G [3], the mitigation is handover frequency hopping across cells / carriers [1], and the cited test used CMX500 with multiple NR FR1 cells on n41/n78/n79 [48].
【推論】The non-signaling tester role is limited to RF / throughput / sensitivity-style verification around the DUT, because the supported non-signaling use cases are RF measurements, sensitivity, throughput, and non-signaling verification [16], while the anti-jam mechanism itself depends on 5G handover signaling [1].

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › unresolved
- [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 的引用版本與 handover interruption interval 章節未標示。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 沒有 modem A / B 型號、chipset 或 firmware。
- 白皮書沒有實體 smart jammer 測試條件；jammer waveform、jammer power、tracking delay、hop prediction capability 與 attack success rate 未標示。
- Defense Prime Investment 與 program examples 缺少完整外部文件與資料口徑。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 23.501]] V15.4.0（2018-12）做 QoS table，但是否需用 newer release 做正式 mission-critical assessment 未裁決。
- Future work 包含 MOS、more random frequencies、dual connectivity、multi-connectivity 與 [[DAPS]] handovers；本來源尚未提供結果。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[DUT]]：本概念的限制條件是 unmodified 5G DUT。
- [[Handover frequency hopping]]：白皮書中最具體的 implementation。
- [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]：本概念的主要技術方向。
- [[Smart Jamming]]：本概念要處理的 threat model。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：白皮書明示測試使用 CMX500 作為 network emulator；但該 Market source 不是 CMX500 binding specifications。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]]：簡報 mid-term roadmap 提到 drone detection 與 perimeter defense，但不是 counter-UAV 系統評估來源。
- [[Beamforming]]：簡報短期 roadmap 提到 mmWave phased arrays field testing，但沒有 beamforming 定義或測試方法。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Program / roadmap 脈絡
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把 private 5G resilience 放入 defense / Future-G roadmap：

| 期間 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 2025–2028 | widespread deployment of 5G tactical networks；mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；hybrid commercial / military networks such as 5G.MIL-style architectures |
| 2028–2032 | 5G/6G-capable software-defined radios replacing multi-radio tactical stacks；early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection and perimeter defense；[[URLLC]] services for autonomy |
| 2032–2035+ | full 6G networks with integrated sensing；AI-native battlefield connectivity；high-precision location sensing and spectrum-aware autonomy |

來源也列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] 與 [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing programs，作為 FHSS 與 5G convergence 的 program examples。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

- mission context 包含 rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics。
- problem statement 指向 current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming。
- source problem question 是：是否能在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，使用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] capabilities 強化連線。
- outcome 語境稱，在 smart-jammer pressure 下，both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；但簡報沒有完整數值。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）提供更具體描述：newer, cheaper and more powerful [[RF]] equipment for consumer use, like [[SDR]] devices, can easily be converted into smart jammers；這些 devices can track the used frequency of the communications and transmit noise at specific moments to disrupt the communications while being difficult to track。

Smart Jamming › 與一般 jamming 的區分限制
目前來源可以支持以下敘述：

- smart jamming 與 [[SDR]] accessibility 相關；來源把 cheaper / more powerful consumer RF equipment 視為 threat enabler。
- smart jammer 被描述為會追蹤 used frequency，而非只做固定頻率或寬頻干擾。
- smart jammer 在 specific moments 發射 noise，因此其 detection / tracking 較困難。

但來源仍沒有提供正式 taxonomy，不能區分其是否屬於 broadband noise jammer、spot jammer、swept jammer、protocol-aware jammer、reactive jammer 或 AI-assisted jammer。

Smart Jamming › 對 5G private networks 的影響
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 中的 operator expectation mismatch 是：operators expect commercial-grade throughput under adversarial conditions。也就是 private 5G / tactical edge 期待維持 throughput 與 video-call reliability，但 smart jamming / [[EW]] 使連線服務連續性變成問題。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 則把影響放在 mission-critical use cases：emergencies、disasters、military operations、essential public services 與 potentially NATO / DoD public-private 5G networks。來源強調 reliability is of upmost importance and should not be compromised in such an accessible way。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是本概念在 private 5G / tactical network 場景下的主頁。
- [[Handover frequency hopping]] 是目前來源中最具體的 mitigation implementation。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]] 中的 [[RF Jammers]]、[[GPS Spoofers]] 與 detection / neutralization 技術同樣屬 contested RF / countermeasure 脈絡，但 [[Counter UAV tech]] 未描述 5G smart jamming。
- [[UAV 通訊]] 與 [[UAV 通訊頻段]] 涉及 UAV C2 / telemetry / payload links；不可由 UAV 頻段表推論 smart jammer 的 5G 攻擊頻段。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] white paper《5G hardening against smart jammer attacks》，文件標示 **PD 3610.1591.52 | Version 01.00 | August 2025 (ch)**，作者為 [[Miguel Villanueva Fernandez]] 與 [[Kristian Hausgaard Soerensen]]。raw frontmatter 顯示原始 PDF 於 2026-09-17 轉檔；本文內容日期以文件頁尾的 August 2025 為準。

白皮書主張：mission-critical、critical infrastructure 與 military 5G use cases 需要比商用網路更高的可靠性；但較便宜且可取得的 [[SDR]] equipment 可能被改造成 [[Smart Jamming]] 裝置，追蹤目前使用的通訊頻率並在特定時刻發射 noise 以干擾連線。來源提出以 [[Handover frequency hopping]] 作為 5G overlay countermeasure：利用所有 3GPP-compliant commercial 5G devices 都支援的 legacy [[5G Handover]] procedure，在不同 carrier frequency / cell 之間切換，使 jammer 必須持續偵聽並重新調整攻擊頻率。

來源明確把這個方法連到論文〈Enhancing 5G Resilience to Smart-Jammer Attacks: Incorporating Frequency Hopping to 5G〉，並說該論文提交給 Spring 2025 IEEE VTC conference，由 [[Aalborg University]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz Technology Center Denmark]] 合作完成。

主要測試設備與條件：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator；來源說 at the time of writing 可達 Release 18 features。
- 測試 CMX500 配置有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，提供四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 使用 control PC 控制 CMX500、measurement PC 控制 [[UE]]；M.2 modem 可直接以 RF cables 連到 CMX500，phone 類 DUT 則使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 使用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79；center frequencies 分別為 2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- 基本 HO repetition interval 為 5 s，除非另有指定；UE received power 固定為 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping frequency 100 Hz，即每 10 ms 一個 ICMP message；iPerf data rate 每秒更新一次；target uplink / downlink data rate 均為 2 Mbit/s，因來源稱這是 good quality video streams 的 minimum requirement。

主要量測結果：

[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把方法映射到：

- [[5G Handover]] signaling procedure；
- 5G frequency-hopping / frequency agility behavior；
- UE-reported band support；
- [[HO interruption interval]]，並標註 message definitions / intervals per [[3GPP TS 38.300]]。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 進一步說明：5G operates on a fixed frequency for each cell；雖然已有 limited form of frequency hopping，但它 confined to the cell bandwidth and resource block allocation。白皮書提出利用 inter-frequency handover 在不同 cells / carriers 間切換，讓 5G 表現得像 frequency hopping。

### A&D requirement → measurable parameter → Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| **Market requirement** | Aerospace / Defense context is explicitly tied to “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient” by Randy Schnell, Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test [55]. The mission drivers include tactical edge connectivity needs, smart jamming / EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, tactical private 5G networks on military bases, and secure command-and-control networks [3]. |
| **Technical mechanism to test** | The resilience problem is mapped to **5G handover signaling** and **5G frequency-hopping / FHSS capabilities** [1]. The concrete implementation is **handover frequency hopping**, using 5G handover across multiple cells / carrier frequencies so the jammer must constantly listen and readjust [1]. The prerequisite is highly reliable inter-frequency handovers while the carrier frequency is constantly changing [1]. |
| **Measurable parameters** | The test design focuses on UE-reported supported bands and handover interruption intervals from 3GPP TS 38.300 [36]. The white paper-level measurements include handover interruption, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS [43]. The described setup used a 5 s handover repetition interval, UE received power of -70.2 dBm, ping at 100 Hz / every 10 ms, iPerf updated once per second, and target UL/DL data rates of 2 Mbit/s for video-stream quality [48]. |
| **Required Signaling Tester capability** | The tester must support 5G network emulation and signaling because the mitigation is based on 5G handover signaling [1]. The white paper used R&S CMX500 as the 5G network emulator / radio communication tester [46], with two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and up to eight cells, and the test used three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 at 2.50713 GHz, 3.30087 GHz, and 4.62399 GHz [48]. CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [7]. Its listed features include NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, GUI, scripting, XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [7]. |
| **Required Non-signaling Tester capability** | For non-signaling work, the supported CMX500 Callbox use cases include sensitivity testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [16]. CMX500 is also described as supporting FR1 / FR2 RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [9]. |
| **Gap** | The passages do not establish that a **non-signaling-only** tester can validate the handover-frequency-hopping resilience mechanism, because that mechanism is explicitly mapped to 5G handover signaling [1]. The sources also do not provide jammer waveform, jammer power, tracking delay, hop prediction capability, attack success rate, jammer reacquisition time, or jamming success probability [2][45]. |
【推論】For this A&D resilience chain, the signaling tester requirement is multi-cell / multi-carrier 5G SA network emulation with inter-frequency handover control and measurement, because the market problem is smart-jamming resilience in tactical/private 5G [3], the mitigation is handover frequency hopping across cells / carriers [1], and the cited test used CMX500 with multiple NR FR1 cells on n41/n78/n79 [48].
【推論】The non-signaling tester role is limited to RF / throughput / sensitivity-style verification around the DUT, because the supported non-signaling use cases are RF measurements, sensitivity, throughput, and non-signaling verification [16], while the anti-jam mechanism itself depends on 5G handover signaling [1].

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] white paper《5G hardening against smart jammer attacks》，文件標示 **PD 3610.1591.52 | Version 01.00 | August 2025 (ch)**，作者為 [[Miguel Villanueva Fernandez]] 與 [[Kristian Hausgaard Soerensen]]。raw frontmatter 顯示原始 PDF 於 2026-09-17 轉檔；本文內容日期以文件頁尾的 August 2025 為準。

白皮書主張：mission-critical、critical infrastructure 與 military 5G use cases 需要比商用網路更高的可靠性；但較便宜且可取得的 [[SDR]] equipment 可能被改造成 [[Smart Jamming]] 裝置，追蹤目前使用的通訊頻率並在特定時刻發射 noise 以干擾連線。來源提出以 [[Handover frequency hopping]] 作為 5G overlay countermeasure：利用所有 3GPP-compliant commercial 5G devices 都支援的 legacy [[5G Handover]] procedure，在不同 carrier frequency / cell 之間切換，使 jammer 必須持續偵聽並重新調整攻擊頻率。

來源明確把這個方法連到論文〈Enhancing 5G Resilience to Smart-Jammer Attacks: Incorporating Frequency Hopping to 5G〉，並說該論文提交給 Spring 2025 IEEE VTC conference，由 [[Aalborg University]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz Technology Center Denmark]] 合作完成。

主要測試設備與條件：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator；來源說 at the time of writing 可達 Release 18 features。
- 測試 CMX500 配置有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，提供四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 使用 control PC 控制 CMX500、measurement PC 控制 [[UE]]；M.2 modem 可直接以 RF cables 連到 CMX500，phone 類 DUT 則使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 使用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79；center frequencies 分別為 2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- 基本 HO repetition interval 為 5 s，除非另有指定；UE received power 固定為 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping frequency 100 Hz，即每 10 ms 一個 ICMP message；iPerf data rate 每秒更新一次；target uplink / downlink data rate 均為 2 Mbit/s，因來源稱這是 good quality video streams 的 minimum requirement。
